_about: Forecast motion settings. HubSpot definitions (pipelines, stage IDs, fields, weighting) are NOT here; they come from gtm-dashboard/config.json via scripts/build.mjs.

cutoff.late_rule_note: Decision 2026-09-25: a submission after Friday 12:00 ET counts toward the following Friday's forecast week.
cutoff.holiday_note: Decision 2026-09-25: no holiday adjustments. A missed holiday week renders as a gap.

forecast_period.end_rule: Dec 31 of the forecast_week's calendar year
forecast_period.start_rule: max(submission date ET, Jan 1 of that year)

drive.test_folder_note: Sales Forecasts/_test (Sales Forecast tool test mode), created 2026-09-25. Runtime test mode is switched on by Script Property FORECAST_TEST_FOLDER_ID = this ID; delete the property to go live. Also used for Phase 4 synthetic snapshots. Never the production folder.

commit.label: Commit (Worst Case)
commit.note: Decision 2026-09-25: broadened from 99% to High Confidence. Operating definition (Notion, 2026-09-18): verbal commitment received from the customer, even with residual contract-negotiation risk.

best_case.label: Best Case
best_case.confidence: Maximum if every toss-up deal closes won

definitions.nesting_rule: Commit ⊆ Gut ⊆ Best Case, so submitted values must satisfy Commit ≤ Gut ≤ Best Case.
definitions.incremental: All values are incremental closed-won USD between submission date and forecast period end, on top of Closed Won YTD.

section1._note: Decision 2026-09-25 (Q4): headline = all open stages and close dates (ties to gtm-dashboard); sub-line = close date ≤ period end incl. past-due; Best Case warning compares to in-period.

weighting.hubspot_weighted_amount: pulled for reference only; never used in any total
weighting.decision: 2026-09-25: only 4 of 49 populated weighted_amount values equal amount × stage probability; stored values total $4.20M vs $5.96M stage-weighted on the same deals. Stage probability used for every open deal.
weighting.notion_definition: Method B: Notion Data Definitions rows 'Weighted deal value (stage probability)' and 'Weighted open pipeline (stage probability)' (Used by: Sales forecast tool, confirmed 2026-09-25). gtm-dashboard uses Method A ('Weighted deal value'). Both are approved and interchangeable per tool, so weighted pipeline intentionally differs between the two tools.

series_colors._about: Validated 2026-09-25 with the dataviz palette validator (light mode, 4 slots, order commit/gut/best_case/closed_won_ytd): lightness band, chroma floor, CVD separation, normal-vision floor, contrast ≥3:1 all PASS. Derived from Findigs Jade, Key-green, Sky, and Sun families (the 60-step anchors failed contrast/lightness). Used identically in Sections 1-3.
